stage_purpose.Zadání: What the client needs to decide. The researcher writes the goal, the decision it feeds, the context and any files. Everything after this stage is checked against it.
stage_purpose.Návrh: The research design: research questions, hypotheses and the comparisons that would answer them. Deep Research can propose design evidence here; a person accepts it.
stage_purpose.Dotazník: The questionnaire: questions and rating batteries. Each item says which research question it measures, so coverage can be checked before anything runs.
stage_purpose.Cílová skupina: Who should answer: filters on AIA's Czech population (age, region, education, subpanels), with a live count of how many people match.
stage_purpose.Dimenze: Which traits the AI respondents carry into their answers (for example ecology or personality), chosen from the population's catalogue.
stage_purpose.Vzorek: How many respondents, whether the design is ready to run, what the run can cost at most, and whether the answers will be reportable at that n.
stage_purpose.Sběr dat: The run itself. AI respondents, fictional or drawn from the population, answer the questionnaire. Each answer is drawn by code from the model's probabilities; progress and cost show live.
stage_purpose.Výsledky: The numbers per question with 95 % intervals. A result is suppressed when its support is too thin, and fictional data is labelled every time.
stage_purpose.Sociomapa: The object map: how respondents relate the rated objects to each other, computed by the signed-off method -5 and drawn as terrain.
stage_purpose.Analýza: Eight analysis modules turn the numbers into findings. A number enters a finding only when the evidence rules admit it; a person reviews each key finding.
stage_purpose.Zpráva: The report: composed from the stages, edited in the editor, approved by a person and downloaded as DOCX or PDF. Only a modelled run gets a client report.

agile: A page or area a person uses (Studie, Vedoucí, Klient …). Engines and Platform are enabler epics: no page, but the pages depend on them.
A plan file in .planning/plans. Each has a status and its chunks in its front matter.
A chunk: one reviewable PR that builds and passes tests on its own.
The MVP. A plan is Core when it carries an MVP gate in the master plan's register (§3.1).
One ordered queue: Now (in flight), Next (the single build session takes these in order), Later (decided but not scheduled).
Merged into develop with CI green and a review on the exact head, the chunk ticked in its plan, and its Doc follow-up applied by the next docs PR.

story.intro: AIA helps a team decide with evidence. A study starts from the decision in Zadání and takes one of two paths, or both. Výzkum asks people, through AI respondents drawn from the Czech population, and maps what they think with the Sociomap. Modely calculates costs and scenarios from the client's own numbers, with the uncertainty shown. Ada, the Research Lead, guides the work in conversation, and a person approves every step that matters. The MVP is built in six waves. Each wave ends at a gate where something new works end to end.

process.d: Each feature has a plan file in the repository, split into chunks. A chunk is a piece of work small enough to review in one sitting.
Build sessions (S1 to S6) each own a lane of chunks. A chunk becomes one pull request with a test that fails before the change and passes after it.
Every pull request passes the automatic checks (CI) and an independent code review (Codex). It merges only when both are clean, and nothing merges without the product owner's word.
Every green merge to develop is deployed to the develop site automatically, so the newest work can always be tried.
A wave is done when all of its chunks are merged and its gate check holds. The next wave starts after that.
Questions only a person can answer (scope, method, money, legal) go to the product owner. The methodology owner signs every statistical method before its numbers reach a client.

waves.name: Ready to build
waves.goal: The groundwork, so that building is safe and fast.
outcomes: Every surface has a named owner, and the sessions know which lane is theirs.
The automatic acceptance test that judges the finished MVP is in place and runs.
AI steps on develop are no longer blocked by the route settings, and a blocked step says who can fix it.

waves.name: Ada runs a study
waves.goal: You run a study by talking to Ada.
outcomes: Ada edits Zadání, Návrh and Dotazník on request; you accept or reject each change one by one.
Two colleagues can work in the same study without overwriting each other.
Ada prepares a plan (for example, "run fieldwork, at most X USD"). You approve it once, and she stops at anything it does not cover.
Fieldwork is quality-checked and shows its progress and cost, and it resumes after a failure without paying twice.
Deep Research reaches the live web (Brave and other sources).
Production exists as a real environment beside develop.
waves.gate: Two people edit one study; a plan approved within its budget starts a run; Deep Research reaches the live web and says which sources it used.

waves.name: Results are seen
waves.goal: Results become something you explore, not only read.
outcomes: The corrected Sociomap of respondents, with segment maps you can drill into.
Ada can talk about the results and point at them.
Map snapshots can be approved for reports, and the report has its approve and export panel.

waves.name: Evidence is complete
waves.goal: Everything a report says can be defended.
outcomes: A client's own data can be used in the analysis, under clear rules.
Open-ended answers are coded into counts, and questionable respondents are flagged.
The Analýza and Zpráva screens are finished, with AI helpers that interpret maps and polish the report.

waves.name: Deep Research joins the report
waves.goal: Outside research becomes part of the deliverable.
outcomes: Deep Research results appear as cards in the conversation with Ada.
The report gains a chapter of outside sources (literature and public data), every quote checked against its source.

waves.name: Acceptance and release
waves.goal: Proof that it all works, then release.
outcomes: Every MVP criterion is run automatically.
A full run on develop within a USD 25 budget.
Production is released after a restore test, a rollback rehearsal and a working "delete this client" path.

tracks.name: Modely and composed reports
tracks.when: Runs beside W2 to W4 on three build sessions (S4 platform and cost model, S5 the statistical method, S6 reports, maps, imported fieldwork and market sizing): 134 to 176 session-days, about 10 to 12 weeks
tracks.goal: A second kind of study beside Výzkumy: decisions calculated from the client's own numbers, with the uncertainty shown, and reports composed for each situation.
outcomes: Cost scenarios from the client's files: every input has a source and a person who vouches for it, up to 12 scenarios per study.

A robust method: data checks, ranges, Monte Carlo, sensitivity, backtested forecasts and the value of more information, judged against a decision rule written before the data. The methodology owner signs every method before its numbers reach a client.
Mapa rozhodnutí: the options and their properties as a Sociomap with a WIND height (up to 30 objects).
Market sizing as a model result with its sources, never a typed number.

Reports composed for each situation: the Lead proposes an outline of chapters (method, contract parties and terms, market, segments, competitors, entry strategy, risks, KPIs, a Sociomap appendix) and a person approves it.
Expert scoring of objects on criteria, imported field surveys labelled "terénní šetření", and bulk and selected Sociomaps.
Výzkum and Modely linked: a survey result becomes the model's assumption when the decision depends on it.
